newsitem.title: CANADA: Smith Barney upgrades Loewen stock.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney upgrades Loewen stock.

text.p: Smith Barney analyst Keith Mullins said Thursday he upgraded his rating on the stock of the Loewen Group Inc to reflect a reduction in investment risk.
Mullins said he changed his stance to buy-high risk from buy-speculative. "The level of risk has meaningfully declined...It's a good time to buy," he said.

Loewen shares were up 1/4 at 30-1/8 on Nasdaq. Mullins said the change reflects his view that the funeral and cemetery operator has put behind it the legal troubles that nearly pushed it into bankruptcy early this year.

The company has avoided negative fallout from a Mississippi lawsuit and shown it will be able to maintain rapid growth, the analyst said. Also Loewen is making progress keeping its costs under control, an area of concern earlier this year, he said.
Loewen's move to list on the New York Stock Exchange, announced Thursday, was another positive factor, he said.

Mullins forecast Loewen's third-quarter earnings per share will rise to US$0.29 from US$0.25 and looked for the stock to reach the mid-40s in about a year. Smith Barney has advised Loewen on several transanctions in recent years.
